name: Go Home.
source:
You are Meff, an ordinary bunny with a great life, but after losing your memory, you have a strange encounter with Death itself after going through an alleyway.

[From [url=https://mege-mege.itch.io/go-home]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是梅夫，一只生活美满的普通兔子。然而失去记忆后，你穿过一条小巷，竟与死神本尊有了一场奇异的邂逅。

（摘自[url=https://mege-mege.itch.io/go-home]itch.io[/url]）
